title: Batman Beyond Rebirth #8 13 14 15 Lot DC 2017-2018 Jurgens Royal Flush Gang
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Batman Beyond (DC Comics, 2016 DC Universe Rebirth series) by Dan Jurgens - 4 comics. $3.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #8 (Jul 2017) - variant cover
- #13 (Dec 2017) - "Gotham Games", Bernard Chang cover
- #14 (Jan 2018) - "The Long Payback" Part One, "Home Sweet Home?"
- #15 - "Return of the Royal Flush Gang"

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
